payload.text: build runs xcodegen only when project.yml or the set of sources changed and xcodebuild Debug or --release with products under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/menuz/build/macos as Intent's and Gtools' do; test runs the MenuzTests target; install builds Release, quits every running copy, replaces ~/Applications/Menuz.app (the siblings' target, D6), unclaims the build products, registers the bundle and launches it with an empty environment; use dev|installed records which build the shim's launch and status use, after devbin's own switch; uninstall, start, stop, restart and stamps as designed; each refuses by name, exit 2, without xcodegen or xcodebuild, and install refuses when native/macos/Menuz is absent.
